business_summary: Eslead Corporation develops and sells family-type and urban condominiums in Japan. The company provides commercial and business facilities, which includes commercial facilities, hotels and vacation rentals, offices, hospices, logistics facilities, nursing homes, and roadside store development; and housing business offers apartment and detached houses. It also engages in the general construction business, which includes apartment, factory, and pavilion construction; and real estate management business offers, rental, electricity supply, large scale repair and renovation, brokerage, hotel operation and management, securitization, and cleaning and security management businesses. In addition, the company engages in solar power generation and digital marketing business. Eslead Corporation was formerly known as Nihon Eslead Corporation and changed its name to Eslead Corporation in October 2019. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Osaka, Japan. Eslead Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Mori Trust Co., Ltd.
